description: SSH public key checker — Check OpenSSH public keys offline (key= one or more URL-encoded lines from id_*.pub or authorized_keys, max 20): type, bits/curve, SHA256 and MD5 fingerprints (same as ssh-keygen -l), comment, authorized_keys options, FIDO hardware keys, duplicates. Verdict per key STRONG/OK/REJECT with reasons (DSA, RSA under 2048, unusual exponent, no comment, unrestricted forwarding). Tolerates + turned into spaces. Refuses private keys. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_ssh_key
